summary: Frontend-only final verification of the 2 residual terminology hits from iteration 252 on a fresh agency tenant (terminology_v6@kora.com, industry=agency, modules program_orchestration + demand_studio, 3 projects promoted to Committed) in Spanish. RESULT: hit (a) EventBinderTab.js:38 is FIXED — with the binder API aborted the toast renders 'Error al cargar Proyecto Binder' and the empty state 'No se pudo cargar el Proyecto Binder'. Hit (b) EventPackingSection.js:430 is NOT FIXED — the literal is unchanged in source (line 431) and still renders on screen: 'Reserva inventario para este evento desde el menú/receta...'. useTerminology is imported at line 4 but `term` is never destructured/used, so the claimed fix was not actually applied. General sweep of all 8 orchestration tabs + dashboard + projects list + calendar found 4 more agency-visible 'Evento/Eventos' strings. Demo tenant deleted at the end.

ui_bugs.issue: NOT FIXED (regression vs. main-agent claim). Documentos > 'Packing List / Montaje' with 0 items still renders 'Reserva inventario para este evento desde el menú/receta o desde Gestión de Recursos → Compras.' / EN 'Reserve inventory for this event...'. useTerminology is imported (line 4) but `term` is never destructured, so no terminology is applied anywhere in this file (line 301 'Selecciona un evento', 582 'Aplicar plantilla al evento', 586 'los invitados del evento' also hardcoded).

Projects list page H1 renders the static i18n key t('events') -> 'Eventos' while the subtitle right below correctly says 'Gestiona tus proyectos y reservas'. This is the most visible instance of the user-reported bug. Should use entityPlural / term('events','entity_plural').

System Pulse > 'Decisiones Recientes' shows 'Evento confirmado' (EN: 'Event confirmed') for an agency tenant, x3. RCA: fetchSystemData useCallback deps are [isEs] only, so entitySingular/entityPlural are captured from the first render before useModules().getProgramOrchestrationConfig() resolves, freezing the default 'Evento/Event'. Same latent bug in the low-inventory alert (line 172-173). Add entitySingular/entityPlural (or poConfig) to the dependency array.
Role catalog option label hardcoded: 'Coordinador de Evento' / 'Event Coordinator' is rendered in the Team & Roles tab for an agency tenant.
/calendar (visible to agency tenants) shows 'Tipos de Evento:' and the 'Agregar Evento' button (i18n key addEvent) instead of Proyecto terminology.
Minor (no user impact today): fetchBinder useCallback deps are [eventId, isEs] but the body now uses `term(...)`; same stale-closure pattern that caused the Dashboard bug. Add `term` to deps.

issues: Tab labels are half-translated for an ES tenant: 'Proyecto Blueprint', 'Operational Flow', 'Team & Roles', 'Production Assets', 'Proyecto Calendar', 'Post-Review', 'Proyecto Binder'. Only 'Documentos' is fully Spanish.
KPI 'INVITADOS' shows '8.00' (float formatting for a head count).
'INVITADOS' / 'Invitados' label kept for an agency tenant; project cards also show '8 invitados'.

design_issues.screen: Login -> first page (agency tenant with organization default_language=es)
issues: App renders in English on a fresh session even though the org config default_language is 'es'; Spanish only appears if localStorage eep_language=es is pre-set. Org default locale is not applied to the UI language.

action_items: EventPackingSection.js: actually apply the terminology fix — destructure `const { term } = useTerminology();` and replace 'este evento' (line 431) plus lines 301/582/586.
EventsPage.js:471 — replace t('events') in the H1 with entityPlural/term('events','entity_plural'); this is the headline 'Eventos' the user reported.
Dashboard.js — add entitySingular/entityPlural (or poConfig) to the fetchSystemData dependency array so 'Evento confirmado' becomes 'Proyecto confirmado'.
CalendarPage.js:422 and LanguageContext addEvent key — terminology-ize 'Tipos de Evento' and 'Agregar Evento'.
Translate the remaining orchestration tab labels to Spanish (Operational Flow, Team & Roles, Production Assets, Post-Review).
Apply organization default_language on session bootstrap instead of relying on localStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: Verify terminology fixes by grepping the literal after editing: EventPackingSection.js was reported as fixed but the string is untouched and useTerminology is an unused import (eslint passes because the import is used-as-import only in name... it is imported and never called, so a no-unused-vars rule tuned for imports would have caught it).

Strings built inside useCallback/fetch handlers freeze terminology values (Dashboard.js:155, EventBinderTab.js:41). Either compute labels at render time or include the terminology values in the dependency arrays.
Two terminology sources still coexist (useTerminology().term vs useModules().getProgramOrchestrationConfig()) — the Dashboard bug is a direct consequence of the async poConfig path.

success_rate.frontend: 1 of 2 targeted hits FIXED (50%); general sweep found 4 additional agency-visible 'Evento' strings

context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro recipe: (1) run /app/test_reports/setup_v6.py create then /app/test_reports/setup_v7.py (promotes using event_id, NOT id); (2) public URL is https://foodops-insights.preview.emergentagent.com (frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) — the older host in iteration 252 is dead; (3) Spanish requires page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('eep_language','es')") BEFORE login, org default_language=es is ignored; (4) project detail URL is /event-orchestration/{event_id}; (5) to reproduce the binder error toast use page.route('**/api/orchestration/binder/**', abort) then click the 'Proyecto Binder' tab; (6) sweep method: click each [role=tab] and regex the body for /\beventos?\b/i. Clean up with /app/test_reports/cleanup_v7.py. Note the demo-accounts list response is a dict with a 'demo_accounts' key and the create response does not echo company_id at the top level.
rca_of_the_issue: Hit (a) was correctly fixed (term('events','entity_singular') in the toast). Hit (b) was never applied: EventPackingSection.js only gained the useTerminology import; the literal 'este evento' at line 431 (and 3 more literals) remain, so the empty state still says 'evento' for agency tenants. The sweep also revealed that the residual hits are of two kinds: (i) hardcoded literals in files never touched by the refactor (EventsPage H1 via the static i18n key, CalendarPage, TeamRolesTab), and (ii) correctly-written terminology that is frozen by stale closures because it is interpolated inside useCallback bodies whose dependency arrays omit the terminology values (Dashboard.js 'Evento confirmado').
